sections.title: Wardrobe Ledger (§14A) — one outfit per story day
sections.md:
Every worn beat shows a bare right knee (shorts or trousers rolled above the knee); the strap is on bare skin.

| D-D2 | R1 Denise | white T-shirt | lavender lightweight zip jacket, open | navy cotton shorts above the knee | white trainers | — | lavender / navy / white | B1-08 |

| A-D2 | R2 Alan | pale blue denim shirt, sleeves rolled | — | stone cotton trousers rolled above the right knee (B1-09a lets it fall; B1-09b down; B2-14 rolled) | brown garden boots | — | denim / stone | B1-09a, B1-09b, B2-14 |
| C-D1 | R3 Clive | grey T-shirt | dark green shop apron | charcoal work shorts above the knee | black trainers | a pencil behind his ear | green / charcoal | B1-10, B2-06a |

| F-D2 | R4 Fiona | grey T-shirt | red waterproof jacket, open | black walking shorts above the knee | brown leather walking boots | a small rucksack | red / black | B1-11 |
| one-off | SG-01 surgeon (§19B approachable: white British man, ~55, pale blue shirt, sleeves rolled, no white coat) | | | | | | blue | B1-01a, B2-11 |

**Novelty (§14A):** no outfit repeats across days, and none repeats a cast sheet's wardrobe.
